name: mygui
description: Fast, flexible and simple GUI: the registry's 3.4.3 port (#4), held by an overlay as the tree reaches MyGUI 3.4.3's privates (Gui::ListBox) and overrides its 3.4 signatures (MyGUIPlatform::DataManager); 3.5 is a step of its own. Without SDL2, which MyGUI asks for its demos and tools alone, and which would bring systemd and D-Bus into the set.
